issuer.summary: apxUSD is issued by Preference Foundation — legally separate from the Nasdaq-listed company behind Apyx, and of undisclosed jurisdiction — so a holder's claim runs against the Foundation, not the listed backer. Disclosure is above average for the category: continuous TEE-attested proof-of-reserves, plus monthly CPA examinations published through July 2026. But the CPA scope narrowed to securities only in April, leaving 43.6% of the reserve unexamined and no opinion on liabilities — and apxUSD sits at 99.63% today. See the full report for the entity structure, custody chain and attestation limits.
issuer.summary_source: SHORTENED 2026-09-10 to a single orienting paragraph at the reader's request; the detail it previously carried now sits in the assessment points below, unchanged. riskAnalyst internal assessment, assets/apxusd.md §Issuer / Counterparty — a section AUTHORED 2026-09-10 and not previously present in this report. ⚠️ PRIMARY SOURCES READ DIRECTLY TODAY, not carried from our prior record: the Wolf & Company July 2026 opinion PDF and its attached Monthly Securities Balance Attestation (docs.apyx.fi/collateral-and-custody/third-party-attestation), and the live Accountable feed. ⚠️ NOT reflected in the published report — tidresearch's apxUSD page does not carry the CPA scope measurement, the SATA-is-zero correction, the 87.35% netted concentration, or the undisclosed-jurisdiction finding. The published report and this summary can be read independently; where they differ, this one is newer and sourced above.
facts: Issuing entity is Preference Foundation — named on every Wolf & Company opinion, with a board and a director of record (July 2026 management certification signed by Carolyn Kelly, Director).

⚠️ Jurisdiction is NOT disclosed by any Apyx source read. The attestations name the Foundation and its brokerage but never its domicile. US/EU/EEA users are restricted, which implies offshore — but that is an inference, not a jurisdiction, and none is asserted here.

⚠️ Recourse runs to the Foundation, not to the Nasdaq-listed backer. The backer presents as team and capital provider; Apyx is a separate legal entity, evidenced by geographic restrictions that would be unnecessary otherwise.

Layer A — Accountable: continuous TEE proof-of-reserves (AWS Nitro Enclave, ZK proofs, Merkle root per snapshot), signing key registered on-chain at 0x5fd592cD004F9089ee56356BD5a46Fa0E62eAf7f. Verified live 2026-09-10: key match true, attestation 18 minutes old. NOT a CPA firm — no qualified opinion, no auditor liability.

Layer B — Wolf & Company, P.C. (Boston, 255 State Street; Allinial Global member): monthly AICPA attestation-standard examinations. March, April, May, June and July 2026 opinions all published; July signed 2026-08-12, an ~12-day lag, so the cadence is current and August is not yet late.

⚠️ Scope narrowed from April onward — a Monthly SECURITIES Balance Attestation, not the Monthly ASSET Balance Attestation of March. Criteria are limited to preferred equity (STRC, SATA) and on-chain tokenized STRCx.

⚠️ 43.6% of the reserve is outside CPA scope: Protocol Owned Liquidity $53.9M, Inventory $55.6M, Cash & Equivalents $25.3M = $134.8M of $309.3M. Both circular legs — the protocol's own positions inside its own backing — are unexamined.
⚠️ Neither layer attests LIABILITIES, so no opinion is expressed on the collateral ratio. apxUSD is undercollateralized at 99.6343% today (−$733,528) and the clean July opinion says nothing about it.
⚠️ SATA is now ZERO — $0 on both 7/20 and 7/31 in the July attestation. The securities leg is STRC $86,261,716 plus STRCx $84,586,268 = $170,847,984. Descriptions of a 'small SATA sleeve' are stale.

⚠️ STRC is 87.35% of NETTED backing, against a 56.4% gross headline. On the issuer's own netted basis — (reserves − POL − inventory) / (supply − POL − inventory), which reproduces their 99.6343% exactly — single-issuer concentration is more than thirty points higher than the headline suggests.
✅ Wolf marks STRCx at the underlying STRC closing price because the on-chain market is thinly traded — the same re-mark this desk applies independently. Recorded as agreement, not as a finding.

⚠️ A naming discrepancy inside the July document, unresolved: Wolf's opinion letter examines 'the Monthly Asset Balance Attestation Report' while the attached signed report is the 'Monthly Securities Balance Attestation'. Probably boilerplate from the March engagement, flagged because an opinion naming a broader report than the one attached is where a scope question would hide.

Custody: STRC/SATA at Alpaca (US brokerage) in the Foundation's name; STRCx in a 3-of-6 Safe sharing all six owners with Apyx's ADMIN Safe. ⚠️ Wolf calls it a 'self-custodied wallet' — it is a multisig, and 3-of-6 with no timelock is the weaker of Apyx's two postures.

Off-ramp: ~$391.5M (84%) of historical MAINTAINER outflows route to a Kraken deposit address (US-licensed, NY BitLicense). ⚠️ Attribution is analyst-derived, NOT Apyx-disclosed — the gap is disclosure, not an unknown destination.
